read.title: Case ID 1234567: Suppressed Listing
read.text:
Hello Seller Support,

I'm writing regarding our listing for the vitamin C serum. It has been suppressed since Monday, and the reason shown is "missing safety information."

We uploaded the safety data sheet on Tuesday, but the listing is still not active. Could you look into this issue? This is our best-selling product, and we are losing sales every day.

If this case needs to be escalated, please let us know what other documents are required.

Thank you,
Minsu Lee
qs: 리스팅이 노출 중지된 이유로 표시된 것은?

write.task: FBA 창고에 입고된 재고가 2주째 '입고 중'으로만 표시돼요. 셀러 지원팀에 상황을 설명하고 확인을 요청하는 문의를 써 보세요.
write.en: Write a message to Seller Support about inventory that has shown 'receiving' for two weeks and ask them to check it.
write.model:
Hello Seller Support,

I'm writing regarding shipment FBA17XK9 of our cica toner pads. It was delivered to the warehouse two weeks ago, but it is still showing as "receiving." Could you look into this? Our stock is running low.

Thank you,
Minsu Lee
